page.layout: Running head at top: page number 150 left, title "Animalium Mar. Ordo X." right. Below the head, two lines of text in small type (French and German captions) at full width. Then a full-width woodcut of a hammerhead shark (no text). A vertical caption printed along the left of the lower woodcut. A woodcut of a hammerhead head (Zygaena) fills the lower page. A catchword-like label "ZYGAE" at the lower right margin.

main_text.head: Animalium Mar. Ordo X.
main_text.p: GALL. Cagnot blau, circa Monspelium, ut supra dictum est.
GERM. F. Ein Blawhund/ein blawer Hundfisch.
Caput hoc Zygaena depictum Cor. Sitterdus ex Italia olim ad me dedit.

page.notes: Two woodcuts: a hammerhead shark seen from above at the top, and a large woodcut of a hammerhead head (Zygaena) seen from below, with the vertical caption "Caput hoc Zygaena depictum Cor. Sitterdus ex Italia olim ad me dedit." printed along its left side. The label "ZYGAE" stands at the lower right edge, partly cut off. The captions are set in small italic type; the vertical caption is transcribed above as a single paragraph. Spellings of the captions are as printed where legible; the French and German lines are transcribed as I read them.
